llm.summary: This skill is a coherent email experiment planning and results-readout helper with no hidden execution or scanner-backed concerns.

dimensions.detail: The artifact's stated purpose is to design email A/B, multivariate, send-time, and hold-out experiments and read exported results; the requested inputs and statistical outputs fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill includes clear boundaries: it does not write email creative, does not compute unrelated quality gates, treats exports as untrusted data, and only applies an action when a named owner and precommitted rule exist.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The reviewed artifact contains only a Markdown SKILL.md file and no install-time scripts, executables, hooks, or hidden setup behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It may use user-provided ESP, analytics, or ecommerce exports and optionally keyed ESP MCP/API integrations, which is proportionate for experiment analysis but involves potentially sensitive business data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It can write a dated memory summary only after asking the user; no automatic persistence, privilege escalation, background worker, or credential harvesting is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want help designing and interpreting email experiments using your own campaign and analytics data. Review any ESP or analytics connector permissions before use, and avoid sharing exports that contain more customer or revenue detail than needed for the analysis.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: SkillSpector reported zero issues; artifact review found no hidden, unrelated, destructive, or exfiltrating behavior that would override that clean result.
[Static scan clean result] expected: Static scan reported no findings, and the artifact contains no executable code or install mechanism.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: VirusTotal showed no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not solely determine the benign verdict.
[Optional ESP/API and exported-data handling] expected: The skill discusses manually exported marketing data and optional keyed ESP convenience integrations, which are disclosed and aligned with email experiment design and readout.
[User-approved memory write] expected: The only persistence instruction is to ask before saving a dated summary under a skill-specific memory path, which is disclosed and bounded.
